title: Holomorphic structure of massive scalar fields in $\text{(A)dS}_2$
summary: Scalar field theories in $\text{(A)dS}_{2}$ with integer scaling dimensions $Δ= k+1$ are characterised by the existence of a pair of (anti-)holomorphic higher-spin currents. We explore the consequences of this to describe their quantisation and subsets of their linear and non-linear symmetries, taking care to treat $\text{AdS}_{2}$ and $\text{dS}_{2}$ separately.
